base_url.description: The base URL endpoint for Xelon HQ. Default is `https://hq.xelon.ch/api/v2/`. Alternatively, can be configured using the `XELON_BASE_URL` environment variable.

token.description: The Xelon access token. Alternatively, can be configured using the `XELON_TOKEN` environment variable.

backup_job_id.description: The ID for the backup job.

enable_monitoring.description: Whether to enable monitoring for the device.

memory.description: The amount of RAM in GB to allocate to the device.

connected.description: Whether the network should automatically connect when the device powers on.

ipv4_address.description: The static IP address for the network connection.

ssh_key_id.description: The ID of the SSH key to be used for authentication.
